name: Firelings Reborn
summary: Firelings Reborn is a Gorilla Tag fangame hangout experience set in a fiery, volcanic world where players take on the role of flame-powered apes called Firelings. Designed for chill exploration and social interaction, the game features lava-themed environments, cozy caves, parkour zones, and secret areas to discover with friends.
